fusions.name: Bring It Down
fusions.desc: Sets the swarm on an enemy at or below 30% health for 20 damage. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Pack in Full Cry
fusions.desc: A cone of sound 5 tiles ahead of you deals 26 resonating damage to everything in it. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Faithful Scavengers
fusions.desc: The swarm eats up to 2 conditions off the ally who needs it most, and they regain 10 health.

fusions.name: Husk Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound runs with you, biting enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
